ἀμήν πρός Κορινθίους δευτέρᾳ ἐγράφη ἀπό Φιλίππων τῆς Μακεδονίας διά Τίτου καί Λουκᾶ.¶ (amēn pros Korinthious deutera egraphē apo Philippōn tēs Makedonias dia Titou kai Louka) 'Amen to Corinthians second it was written from Philippi of Macedonia through of Titus and Luke.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
